This video features a real-time challenge where a man named Darcy must escape a five-floor tower in 10 minutes to prevent a room full of money from exploding (00:00). The entire video is exactly 10 minutes long with no cuts, and an unbroken shot of Darcy is shown in the corner to prove its real-time nature (00:00).

Darcy's challenges include:
*   Escaping a straight jacket (00:00).
*   Picking a lock on a metal cage with fire (00:00).
*   Swinging across a gap to the next floor (02:06).
*   Descending a rope to the third floor, the "boulder room," where he must use a machete to cut two ropes preventing a giant boulder from rolling (02:06). He struggles with cutting the thick rope (02:06).
*   Later, he struggles with latches and must slide through a door to hit a button (09:18).

Ultimately, Darcy succeeds with 19 seconds left (09:18). He reveals he is having a baby the next day, and then the building is blown up (09:18).
